## Checklist

- [ ] I edited the sources, not the generated files (see CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [ ] A component change is in all three places: `soft-2/index.html`, `packages/react` and `tools/pages/content/<id>.json`
- [ ] I ran the build steps the change needs (`npm run build`, `react`, `astro`, `pages` from `tools/site`) and committed the output
- [ ] Checked in Soft and Blueprint, light and dark, at 1440, 768, 390 and 360
- [ ] No console errors and no sideways scroll
- [ ] Card heights measured again if a component's height changed
- [ ] Docs and copy say only what the code does
